en.name: Basilica of Superga, Turin
en.summary: A hilltop basilica overlooking Turin, built to fulfill a vow made during a decisive eighteenth-century siege.
en.body: Built between 1717 and 1731 in fulfillment of a vow made by Duke Victor Amadeus II during the 1706 siege of Turin, the basilica crowns a hill overlooking the city and serves as the burial place of the House of Savoy.
